## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `c72c8a04ca5633a6c054ffd2701350d95ed7cd8f`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #32760 body and all five comments (triage 6828393064, re-grade 6837951505, claim 6880548960, amendment 6880606745, os-dev-report 6881549558); PR #33366 body and its six-file list; the net diff `71ade1ae..c72c8a04`; the server door on `origin/main`; the check-runs on this head.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `MetadataGetOptions.callerPackage?: string` (metadata-client.ts:494-505, sent at :1263). Right.** It only widens the interface: an optional member, sent as `callerPackage=` and left out when absent or `''`. No member is removed or narrowed, and a call that omits it sends the same bytes as before (the CONTROL row pins this). The interface is already exported from the package entry (index.ts:8411), so nothing new is exported. `getDraft` keeps its own narrower options type and does not forward the new member, which is correct, because the door serves the caller arm on `dataset` reads only.
- **The parameter is live on the server, so the fix is not inert. Right.** On `origin/main`, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` defines `META_ITEM_CALLER_PACKAGE_PARAM = 'callerPackage'` (:2397) and lists it in `META_ITEM_READ_PARAMS` (:2385). It sits in the `once` arity set (:2492). Rule 4 of `metaItemQueryRefusal` refuses it with `400` when it is blank or `all`, when `package` is also present, or on any type but `dataset` (:2614-2633). `metaCallerPackageQuery` (:2665) resolves the reader's package by D3 (its own item, else the one holder in its closure plus `sys`, else `409`) and rewrites the read to the holder's `package`. Both transports call it: `meta-item-read-routes.ts:491` (RestServer) and `runtime/src/domains/meta.ts:2062` (dispatcher). The client spelling matches the server param exactly, and the client never sends it beside `packageId` from this caller.
- **app-shell `ReportView.handleDatasetDrill` (ReportView.tsx:138-143, deps :180). Right.** The fallback now reads `get('dataset', NAME, { callerPackage: servedPackageId(editSchema || reportData) })`, or `{}` when the report has no package. That is the same value the renderer's `ReportPackageContext` gets: `previewReport` is `editSchema || reportData` (:406), and `DatasetReportRenderer` provides `servedPackageId(props.report)`. So the drill reads the same dataset the report's own queries resolve. `editSchema` was correctly added to the `useCallback` deps. A refusal is still caught by the existing `catch`: no drawer, no bare retry. I checked the dev's premise against `service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts` on `main`. `drillDims` filters out `type: 'date'` (:3360), and `drillRanges` comes only from granularity or window dims. So a report grouped by a date dimension with no granularity does reach this branch, and keeping it (not deleting it) is the right arm of the card's item 3. `useMetadataClient` returns the real `MetadataClient`, so the option reaches the transport.
- **Nothing app-shell or console publishes changes shape.** `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`. It has no export change, only internal behaviour. `@object-ui/console` is public (`publishConfig.access: public`). It ships the prebuilt SPA that bundles app-shell, so its users see a behaviour patch and no API change. `@object-ui/core` is only imported (`servedPackageId` was already exported, and app-shell already depends on core). `@object-ui/plugin-charts` changes a test file only. Its `files` is `dist` plus docs, so nothing published moves (`ObjectChart.tsx` is not edited).
- **Item 2 pin (ObjectChart.optionColors.test.tsx:460-496). Right.** A `409` whose body also carries a definition naming `task` is the case that tells the status guard apart: without the guard the probe would read `meta/object/task`. The dev's ablation B1 reds only this row, which matches the card's ask.
- **Item 1 dropped. Right.** There is no `.changeset/32077-*` on `origin/main`, and the card itself says to drop the item if a release cut between. No pending changeset is edited.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset `.changeset/32760-report-drill-caller-package.md` names `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/app-shell` (private, versioned under `privatePackages.version: true`) and `@object-ui/console`, all at `patch`. Every package whose shipped output moves is named: data-objectstack `dist`, and console via its bundled app-shell. plugin-charts is correctly left out because only a test changed. All four are in the root `fixed` group, so the release bump is shared anyway.
- `patch` is correct under AGENTS.md: a non-protocol widening ships `patch`, and `Metadata-protocol: none` holds because no authorable key, value, type or stored shape changes. `check-changeset-no-major` was exit 0 per the dev's gate record.
- The declaration line in the changeset, in the PR body and in the amended claim 6880606745 reads `Clause-②: yes (widening)` in all three places, and it matches the diff: one optional member is added and nothing is narrowed. The original claim's `no` was amended before the edit.
- Changeset sentences checked against the diff and the server:
  - "omitted, every read is sent exactly as before": true (`if (options.callerPackage)`).
  - "sends no drill metadata for a `type: 'date'` dimension with no `dateGranularity`": true (analytics-service.ts:3360, plus the `drillRanges` conditions).
  - "A report authored in the environment reads the name bare": true (`servedPackageId` returns undefined for no `_packageId`, `sys_metadata` or `__runtime__`).
  - "A refusal opens no drill and is not retried": true (one `get`, caught).
  - The client paragraph (own item, else the one holder among the declared dependencies plus `sys`, else `409`; distinct from `packageId`; `dataset` only; refused beside `packageId`): true against meta-item-read-gate.ts:2388-2406 and :2614-2633.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. Nothing to answer.
- Deviations:
  - (a) No labels on `pr_create`. Accepted, because a changeset is owed and present.
  - (b) The file surface and `Clause-②` differ from the original claim. Answered: amendment 6880606745 covers both, and the diff stays inside the amended surface: plugin-charts test, ReportView plus its test, metadata-client plus its test, and the root changeset.
  - (c) Local suites were narrowed to the touched packages. Accepted on the condition that CI's sharded `Test UI` answers the rest, which it has not yet done (see gates below).
- Out-of-scope finding (not filed, no carrier). Escalated to the seat: file a `finding` follow-up card in `domain:ui`. On the ReportView fallback, a `type: 'date'` dimension with no granularity filters its field by equality with the displayed group value, and the fallback ignores the `object` the server now sends. Both behaviours predate this PR, and this PR only changes which dataset definition the fallback reads, so this does not block. A filed card is the carrier the brief requires.
- Premise check: the claim says item 3 is "old-server-only or not". The dev measured it and the PR body records the measurement. I confirmed it on `main` above.
- Gates on `c72c8a04`, read from the head's check-runs at review time:
  - Completed `success`: Check Changeset (run 43621856744), Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, filter, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build UI Deps, Plan Test UI shards, Live E2E UI, Type Check · source gates, Auto Label.
  - Still running, and not counted as green: Test UI 1-16/16, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Lint UI, Type Check · workspace / consumer gates / debt ledger, every Lint · job (PM dispatch-gates, docs & code guards, ESLint, scoped slot lookup & corpus, CI release & engine gates, scoped tooling self-tests, scoped query-options erasure, repo & tooling gates), and a second Check Changeset (run 43622068083).
  - Skipped by path filter or opt-in: the rest.
  - No check-run has failed. This verdict is on the contract. Landing still waits for every running gate to finish green.

Findings:
- nit, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx:136. The inline comment still reads "Fallback (older server with no drill metadata)". This contradicts the rewritten header comment at :105-109, which says the branch is not only an older server's. Reword it to "no `objectFilter` arrived".
- should-fix (seat follow-up, not this PR), ReportView.tsx:157-171. The equality filter on a no-granularity date dimension, and the fallback ignoring the answer's `object`, should be carried on a filed `finding` card (see ③).

It now sends `callerPackage = servedPackageId(editSchema || reportData)`, omitted when the report has no package; `MetadataGetOptions.callerPackage` → `?callerPackage=`.
   - Changeset sentences read against the diff: each holds.

6. Out of scope: none.
7. Landing under the maintainer's standing authorisation 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z).

所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/43626642771/job/132544038570)** — 失败步骤: Boot example apps and exercise real user flows

  ```
  @objectstack/dogfood:test:  FAIL   isolated  test/object-unknown-datasource-refusal.dogfood.test.ts > dogfood: an object bound to a datasource that does not exist is refused at save (#26724) > control
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/dogfood:test: Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `test/object-unknown-datasource-refusal.dogfood.test.ts` — 24h 窗口内只有本 PR 撞到过，暂不汇总（再有一个不同 PR 撞到就会自动开汇总 issue）。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 4 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
